source_refs.note: 1- Nucleosome String: a main subheading of 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 117-118.

blocks.text: After replication, approximately every 146 nucleotides of DNA (2 nm thick) wrap twice around a histone octamer (set of 8 histone molecules i.e., two copies each of the histones H2A, H2B, H3, and H4). So, aggregations called nucleosomes are formed. Nucleosomes are connected by about 80 nucleotide long linker DNA. The fifth type of histone i.e., H1 called linker histone is present at the base of the nucleosome near the DNA entry and exit points. It helps in the winding of the chain of nucleosomes. All nucleosomes (without linker histone) resemble beads on a string called nucleosome string (11 nm thick).

blocks.alt: Top: a histone octamer drawn as a disc in two layers, its top divided into four coloured histones H2B, H3, H4 and H2A. Plus a wavy DNA strand of about 146 nucleotides. A green arrow leads to a nucleosome string: DNA wound round three octamers like beads on a string, with the histone H1 at the base of a nucleosome.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.3: Nucleosome string (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 19.3).
blocks.long_description: Labels: H2B, H3, H4, H2A, Histone octamer, DNA (about 146 nucleotides), Nucleosome, H1, Nucleosome string.

blocks.alt: One continuous drawing: the DNA double helix across the top, widening to the right (2 nm); the DNA wound round red histone octamers to make a zigzag row of nucleosomes joined by linker DNA, with yellow linker histones (11 nm); the chromatin fibre running back to the left (30 nm); the beaded supercoil looping back to the right (300 nm); the condensed chromatin coiling to the left (700 nm); and at bottom right the chromosome of two sister chromatids, the 1,400 nm arrow spanning both.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: Organization of chromosome (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 19.4).
blocks.long_description: Labels: DNA, 2 nm, Histone octamer, Nucleosome, Linker DNA, Linker histone, 11 nm, Chromatin fibre, 30 nm, Supercoil, 300 nm, Condensed chromatin, 700 nm, Chromatid, 1,400 nm.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The printed Figure 19.4 labels one chromatid 1,400 nm, while the book's text gives a chromatid as 700 nm. A chromatid is 700 nm; 1,400 nm is the width of the whole chromosome of two chromatids, as drawn above.
